layout: two rows, six racks per row, front/back x bottom/middle/top per rack

edge_semantics.front_to_back: directed server intake-to-exhaust thermal transport; retained as a distinct physical mechanism
edge_semantics.vertical: bidirectional effective mixing between adjacent heights on the same rack side
edge_semantics.same_row_adjacent: bidirectional effective mixing between adjacent racks at the same side and height
edge_semantics.cross_row_matched: bidirectional effective recirculation/mixing between matched rack positions
